title: [anthus-site-content] README describes the old Gatsby/S3/webhook flow; CI builds the old Anth.us repo
description:
**Problem**
The anthus-site-content README describes the retired Gatsby/S3/webhook publishing flow, and its CI still builds the old Anth.us repo. anth.us is now served from an S3 projection of the Papyrus CMS (see AGENTS.md in this repo).

**Evidence**
Audit finding on anthus-site-content README and CI config.

**Fix**
Rewrite the README for the current flow; remove or repoint the CI that builds the old repo.

**How to verify**
README mentions no Gatsby/webhook flow; CI workflow does not reference AnthusAI/Anth.us.

Source: Anthus repo audit, 2026-10-20.
